scope: Protect known GitLab footnote definitions omitted by rendered HTML; this does not implement footnote authoring or certify all GLFM label syntax

fixtureCapture.provenance: Authenticated pinned GitLab 19.5.3 renderer; actual outputs, not fabricated HTML
fixtureCapture.sourceFilterFacts: The host adds a random suffix and processes at most 1000 references. Repeated references do not consistently retain the same class/fragment form.
findings: Unicode and NBSP labels are accepted
Reference/definition source positions use UTF-8 byte columns
Frontmatter examples stay metadata rather than document footnotes

counterexample.scope: Actual parent codec copied from 259ba6fc and exercised offline with the authenticated renderer fixture; not a before-fix browser claim
counterexample.observed: The parent accepts the projection and preserves unchanged Markdown, but canonical export after an unrelated edit drops the unused definition.

implementation.contract: Reuse the native block/container parser for bounded source inspection; never use the inspection grammar's labels as editor IDs, DOM anchors or converted definition content.
implementation.limits: The probe currently bounds labels to 4096 characters and shares the configured input-byte limit. This guard is not a complete GLFM footnote parser.
implementation.frontmatter: Exclude the validated GitLab frontmatter prefix before interpreting document definitions.
implementation.ordinaryDocuments: No extra Markdown parse when there is no definition-like candidate.

models.scope: All GitLab model test files; this checkpoint does not claim a new full-repository unit run

browser.verified: Actual omitted-definition paste refusal, failed saved-load refusal/Retry, retained source, local recovery/cancel, unchanged original source after restart, and ordinary edit/save/reopen.

openImageFinding.observed: The first service run failed after restart when the reader image received HTTP 403 and had naturalWidth 0. A follow-up authenticated request returned 200 with PNG bytes.
openImageFinding.laterRun: The final run passed with no failed image responses. This is not a root-cause fix or a reliability certification.
openImageFinding.diagnostics: The audit now records only allowlisted error words, status, response content type/server/request ID and a body hash. No raw error HTML or request/session headers are persisted; there is no automatic image retry.

validation.productionBuild: passed with two existing asset/entry warnings

remaining: Complete source-aware footnote mapping, omitted-definition materialization, original-label retention and semantic export after edits
Native insert/edit/rename/delete/navigation UI, clear source-only handoff and explicit recovery semantics
Repeated/back-reference reader behavior and full GLFM label/container/browser/permission matrices
Diagnose and repair the observed post-restart uploaded-image 403
Remaining GitLab surfaces, compiled rollback, hosted CI, the other full products and the global roadmap
publication: No public feature claim, parity row, npm version or capacity increase is promoted by this checkpoint.
logFormatting: Tracked terminal receipts normalize ANSI escapes, CRLF and trailing whitespace. Renderer fixtures, native JSON reports, patches and recording hashes are retained as distinct evidence.
